notes.title: Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach - Trading Card Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/f742efbd057b67243927d7a41c3ac7f1567c989f.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Space traveler.

We have a great announcement for all of you out there. Starting now, Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach trading cards are available on Steam! In which, you can gain up to three random trading cards whenever you accumulate your playtime on the game.

You can get Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons. It's definitely great news for our fellow Space travelers to express their love to others on Steam. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/1da9ce6d4d2c96c9d4f1104559e2dcf10908b3a2.png[/img]

You are now viable to obtain and complete a set of five distinctive cards with different looks. The trading cards can be crafted as well so you can upgrade your Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach badges and display them on your Steam profile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/1a4cca073a91fd432fe38ec62ccb4769f07e7e88.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the simple yet elegant looks of our favorite badges.

As always, stay safe out there in space!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631790/Dawnbreaker__Aeons_Reach/

notes.title: Dawnbreaker Aeon’s Reach - Official Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/9a9cd0468d50aebb0836a5f87a2428390a91c24e.png[/img]

[b]CrazySky3D[/b]’s new Visual Novel, [b]Dawnbreaker - Aeon’s Reach[/b] will launch on Steam for Windows and Linux on [b]November 5th[/b] 2021.

[b]Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach[/b] is an erotic visual novel that puts you in the heels of a jaded bounty hunter looking for fun, causing her to embark on a very hot cosmic adventure with a bunch of outlaws. Will you be able to find what you desire in this universe?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/cfa7210538d726ec4b33737edc30ad2bd5c4295e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]A lewd story around 50k+ words long (from 5 to 6 hours of gameplay)
[*]Multiple paths with several different endings
[*]A whole cast of sensual girls for you to meet
[*]4k high-quality graphics
[*]300+ unique CGs with animations
[*]Detailed 3D backgrounds with multiple variations
[*]Image gallery, music room, and replay scene functionality
[*]Achievements, Easter eggs, and more!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631790/

Play the first 2 chapters in the demo and learn more about the story of Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach.
